name: JBFC Summer Camps
description_short: Two week filmmaking and stop motion animation camps at the Jacob Burns Film Center's Media Arts Lab in Pleasantville, in small groups of up to 10 by grade from 4 to 12. Campers write, shoot and edit their own short films or animations and premiere them for families at the JBFC theater.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund for withdrawal by March 31, 50% in April, none after April 30; full refund if JBFC cancels.
special_needs_notes: Families are asked to tell the JBFC about an IEP or any needed accommodations so staff can support the camper.
notes: 2026 prices were $2,100 for filmmaking and $2,000 for animation if registered by February 15, then $2,200 and $2,100. Days run 9 to 3; campers bring lunch and the JBFC provides a popcorn snack. Nut free. Closed August 3 to 7. Registration for 2026 is closed and 2027 is not posted yet; every 2026 filmmaking session filled.
